context:
For each platform doc, locate the "Platform Options" or "Configuration" section and
add a new subsection immediately after the options table:

### Testing a Specific [Platform Name] Version

```bash
benchbox run --platform [platform] --benchmark tpch \
  --platform-option driver_version=X.Y.Z \
  --platform-option driver_auto_install=true
```

See {ref}`driver-version-management` for the full guide, including why `uv run` may
revert a manually-installed version and how to work around it.

Use the exact same wording as duckdb.md lines 79-88 for consistency, substituting
the correct platform name and a realistic version number (e.g., polars 1.36.1,
clickhouse-connect 0.10.0, psycopg2-binary 2.9.11).

For driver-version-management.md, add one example per platform to the
"Pattern 1: driver_auto_install" block - a brief comment line + the benchbox run
command is sufficient (no new sections needed).
description:
The DuckDB platform doc (docs/platforms/duckdb.md) was updated in the previous TODO
(document-driver-version-selection-behavior) to include a "Testing a Specific DuckDB Version"
section with a concrete example and a cross-reference to the driver-version-management guide.

Three other platform docs are missing equivalent coverage:

  docs/platforms/polars.md
    - No mention of driver versioning. After the polars extra is made optional, users
      will need to know how to install a specific polars version.

  docs/platforms/clickhouse-cloud.md
    - No driver versioning section. The platform uses clickhouse-connect; users may want
      to pin a specific connector release for reproducibility.

  docs/platforms/postgresql.md
    - Has basic install info but no guidance on driver version selection or the uv.lock
      revert issue.

The fix for each file is the same pattern used for duckdb.md:
  1. Add a "Testing a Specific [Platform] Driver Version" subsection under Configuration
     or Platform Options, with a concrete --platform-option driver_version example
  2. Add a {ref}`driver-version-management` cross-reference link

Additionally, the driver-version-management.md guide itself should reference these
platforms in its examples (currently it only shows duckdb and snowflake examples).

anti_patterns.dont: add version numbers that don't match the current optional-extra floors
anti_patterns.instead: use the same versions as pyproject.toml optional extras

anti_patterns.dont: duplicate the full driver-version-management guide content in each platform doc
anti_patterns.instead: add only a short example + link

preserves.behavior: Existing content in all four docs files is not removed or restructured - only append new sections
The {ref}`driver-version-management` cross-reference format matches what is used in duckdb.md
driver-version-management.md remains the single authoritative guide - platform docs link to it, not duplicate it
